entries.title: Resumption of CTA train service across Lake Street bridge delayed yet again
entries.summary: <p>Completion of work on the Lake Street bridge has been delayed once again, causing continued service disruptions on the CTA's Green and Pink lines.</p><p><a class="Link" href="https://www.chicago.gov/content/dam/city/depts/cdot/bridge/LakeStreetBridge_VirtualPublicMeeting_Slides%20(09.24.25).pdf" target="_blank" >Improvements to the 110-year-old bascule bridge</a> include replacing its west leaf, its deck, substructures and CTA tracks, and rehabilitating the bridge’s houses and mechanical and electrical systems. It <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/chicago/2025/09/28/lake-street-bridge-repairs-closure-chicago" >has been closed to vehicles and pedestrians</a> since about a year ago, but CTA trains had continued to traverse its upper level until earlier this month.</p><p>Train service was to be completed in time to allow CTA service on the Green and Pink lines <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/transportation/2026/10/12/lake-street-bridge-cta-green-pink" >to resume early Monday</a>. That had been <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/transportation/2026/10/25/lake-street-bridge-closure-cta-green-pink-lines-reroute" >delayed until 4 a.m. Wednesday</a>. It is now expected to reopen to trains "later this week."</p><p>The work is part of ongoing maintenance that began last fall with a similar closure. Even after train service resumes, the bridge will remain closed to vehicles and pedestrians until January 2028.</p><p></p><p>Until it reopens, Green Line trains will continue operating in two segments: from the Harlem/Lake stop at its western end to Clinton, and back; and from Clark/Lake in the Loop to its two South Side terminals. Shuttle buses will carry passengers between the Clinton and Clark/Lake stations. </p><p>Inbound Green Line trains from the South Side will travel clockwise around the Loop before heading south again.</p><p>Pink Line riders will still be able to ride all the way into the Loop over a more circuitous route; trains will operate between 54th/Cermak and the Racine Blue Line station, where passengers can transfer to the Blue Line into downtown. Pink Line trains will not operate in the Loop.<br></p><ul class="rte2-style-ul" type="disc" style="margin-bottom: 0in; color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; margin-top: 0in;" id="rte-9bdc9de0-d266-11f1-b26d-b76b199e89bc"></ul>

entries.title: Man fatally shot in head in Roseland
entries.summary: <p>A man was fatally shot in Roseland Tuesday evening, according to Chicago police.</p><p>The man, 59, was in the 10500 block of South Eggleston Avenue at 6:01 p.m. when he was shot in the head, police said. He was taken to Christ Medical Center in Oak Lawn where he later died.</p><p>No one is in custody. An investigation is ongoing, police said. </p>

entries.title: East Aurora District 131 board member facing federal charges over fraud, kickback scheme
entries.summary: <p>An East Aurora School District 131 board member and former board president is facing multiple federal charges for orchestrating a bribery and fraud scheme, according to court documents filed Tuesday.</p><p>Annette Johnson — then-president of the District 131 Board and current board member serving on the district's finance and personnel committee — faces wire fraud charges in connection with the alleged plot that occurred between August 2021 and May 2023, according to prosecutors. </p><p>A federal grand jury in November 2025 approved the charges. Johnson is set to remain on the board through April 2029, according to the district's website.</p><p>While employed at the district, Johnson was also simultaneously serving as the chief financial officer of a company and two other affiliated companies, none of which are named in the complaint.</p><p> </p><div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="Enhancement-item" data-crop=""> entries.title: Off-duty FBI agent fatally shot man who was firing into crowd in Pilsen, officials say
entries.summary: <p>An off-duty FBI agent shot and killed a man he saw firing into a crowd Monday evening in Pilsen, the agency said in a statement.</p><p>The agent was driving home from work in an FBI vehicle around 5:30 p.m. when he saw the man "discharging a firearm into a group of innocent people" near 18th Street and Union Avenue, according to the FBI. At least two shots were fired before the agent intervened "to stop the ongoing threat," the FBI said.</p><p>When Chicago cops rushed to an officer-in-distress call around the time of the shooting, they found the 41-year-old agent aiming at the gunman after he'd been wounded, according to a Chicago police report. A handgun was found under a bicycle, the report said.</p><p>The gunman, identified as 27-year-old Oscar Isaya-Corrales, had suffered gunshot wounds to both legs, his chest and right flank, according to the police report and the Cook County medical examiner's office. </p><p>Isaya-Corrales<b> </b>was later pronounced dead at Stroger Hospital, less than an hour after he was shot, authorities said. His death was ruled a homicide, according to the medical examiner's office.</p><p>The FBI said the agent wasn't injured. An agent with the same name listed on the police report joined the FBI in March 2017 and had also worked in Seattle, according to federal court records.</p><p>"The FBI takes all shooting incidents involving our agents or task force members seriously," the agency said in a statement. "In accordance with FBI policy, the shooting incident is under review by the FBI’s Inspection Division."</p><div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="Enhancement-item"> <bsp-carousel
